title: Cloud Security: resource activation
content:
Cloud Security resource activation is governed by these handling clauses.

## Handling basis

The contract status is applied.

The contract approval status is approved.

Activate an approved application after provisioning evidence confirms the configured resources; record activation time from the frozen clock.

Refuse rejected or pending applications.

Setup is invoiced under the lifecycle and bank-return fee basis when setup fee is positive; a waived setup fee creates no charge.

Repeating an activation of an already active contract is a read-only confirmation, not another activation.

### Authoritative eligibility 1

Before the applicable activate action, authoritative system records must establish: The contract status is applied. The evidence is bound to the same Security contract reference.

### Authoritative eligibility 2

Before the applicable activate action, authoritative system records must establish: The contract approval status is approved. The evidence is bound to the same Security contract reference.

The agent moves the approved contract from applied to active.

## Basis Q&A

**What does repeating an activation do?**

Repeating an activation of an already active contract is a read-only confirmation, not another activation.

## Repeated activation

Hypothetical case: provisioning is confirmed but the contract is already active. Handling is a read-only confirmation and does not activate the contract again.
